name: Tax Charges 2
definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters such as thresholds or income.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique reference to unambiguously identify the nature of the tax levied, such as Value Added Tax (VAT).

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Rate used to calculate the tax.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money resulting from the calculation of the tax.
